mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined usually in terms of inability of workers who are willing to work and are searching for work to get one."
Unemployment is defined usually in terms of inability of workers who are willing to work and are searching for work to get one.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to unemployment arising because there is mismatch of skills and opportunities when the pattern of demand and production changes."
Structural unemployment refers to unemployment arising because there is mismatch of skills and opportunities when the pattern of demand and production changes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of improving the quality of all human lives."
Development is the process of improving the quality of all human lives.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a term used to refer to the existence of disproportionate distribution of total national income among households."
Income inequality is a term used to refer to the existence of disproportionate distribution of total national income among households.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the term economists often use for education, health and other human capacities that can raise productivity when increased."
Human capital is the term economists often use for education, health and other human capacities that can raise productivity when increased.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the greatest in the poorest countries."
The educational gender gap is the greatest in the poorest countries.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the newest, most exciting, and most challenging branches of the disciplines of economics."
Economics of development is one of the newest, most exciting, and most challenging branches of the disciplines of economics.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as "meeting the needs of the present generation without compromising the needs of future generations"."
Sustainable development can be defined as "meeting the needs of the present generation without compromising the needs of future generations".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a term used to refer to the process by which fertility rates eventually decline to replacement levels."
Demographic transition is a term used to refer to the process by which fertility rates eventually decline to replacement levels.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to Keynesian unemployment when aggregate demand falls and wages and prices have not adjusted to restore full employment."
Demand deficit unemployment refers to Keynesian unemployment when aggregate demand falls and wages and prices have not adjusted to restore full employment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most frequently used words in discussions relating to development, trade and international political economy."
Globalization is one of the most frequently used words in discussions relating to development, trade and international political economy.
fib: ______ is a basic objective of development.
Health like education
Health like education is a basic objective of development.
______ is a better measure, but clearly omits consideration of the general health status of the population beyond only childhood.
infant survival rate
The infant survival rate is a better measure, but clearly omits consideration of the general health status of the population beyond only childhood.
______ refers to organization and associations (including public, private and non profit) as well as to norms and relationships (such as lows, traditions, and personal networks).
Social capital
Social capital refers to organization and associations (including public, private and non profit) as well as to norms and relationships (such as lows, traditions, and personal networks).
______ is the most important stage because it presents the demarcation line between a traditional economy and a modem self sustained economy.
self-sustained stage
The self-sustained stage is the most important stage because it presents the demarcation line between a traditional economy and a modem self sustained economy.
______ is the most recent variant on the neoclassical counterrevolution.
market friendly approach
The market friendly approach is the most recent variant on the neoclassical counterrevolution.
______ means that a country is doing relatively better in terms of human development than in terms of per capita income.
positive difference
A positive difference means that a country is doing relatively better in terms of human development than in terms of per capita income.
______ is a broad and comprehensive concept.
Human development
Human development is a broad and comprehensive concept.
______ is the extent to which unlimited supply of labour is available.
point of departure
A point of departure is the extent to which unlimited supply of labour is available.
______ is one of the most harmful particulate pollutants.
Airborne lead
Airborne lead is one of the most harmful particulate pollutants.

Development diamonds
